title: Scp-4153 The Wax Troupe
style: dark photorealistic found-footage horror photograph, desaturated, heavy 35mm film grain, crushed blacks, one harsh light source, unsettling, vertical composition, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no timestamps, no overlays

credit.author: The Great Hippo
credit.line: Based on SCP-4153 by The Great Hippo - scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-4153 - CC BY-SA 3.0

post_caption: Living wax monsters hide in haunted houses near you. Would you notice which one is real?

Hero.look: Short dark brown hair, dark Foundation jacket with high collar, seen from behind.

scenes.image_prompt: Wide grainy CCTV frame of an empty dark haunted house corridor, large black empty area at top, tiny pale glossy wax figure with melted smooth face standing far away, faint cold light, crushed blacks, film grain, desaturated {style}

lines.text: In 1993, police arrested intruders at a haunted house, then realized the monster faces weren't makeup. They were wax, and alive.

scenes.label: WHAT IT IS
scenes.image_prompt: Close detail of wax drips and smeared pale yellow wax handprints on a carnival wall, fake blood splatter, one dim flashlight glow, nobody in frame, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, desaturated {style}

lines.text: They are an acting troupe of living wax figures playing Dracula, Frankenstein's Monster and the Werewolf, reshaping their faces and moving wax objects from afar.

scenes.label: WHERE THEY HIDE
scenes.image_prompt: Empty carnival haunted-house stage at night, rubber monster masks on the floor, one wrong detail: a glossy pale wax puddle shaped like footprints, single dim red emergency light, heavy grain, desaturated {style}

lines.text: They hide at haunted houses and carnivals across North America, making their own fake blood and gore, so nobody looks twice.

scenes.label: HOW IT'S CONTAINED
scenes.image_prompt: High-corner black-and-white CCTV of an empty interrogation room, tiny motionless pale wax figure draped in a bed-sheet seated far away, glossy melted face, grainy, crushed blacks {style}

lines.text: A secret organization that locks away things that should not exist took them to Site-09.

scenes.label: WHO WATCHES IT
scenes.image_prompt: POV flashlight beam through haze down a dark Site corridor, far end a tall pale yellow wax figure with smooth half-formed face, dripping hands, half swallowed by darkness, heavy grain, desaturated {style}

lines.text: Task force Iota-10 hunts every sighting near horror attractions and brings each one in.

scenes.label: THE MISTAKE
scenes.image_prompt: Over-the-shoulder, out-of-focus back of {Hero}, short dark brown hair, dark Foundation jacket; a pale glossy wax figure with smooth melted face stands in a dark doorway, one cold light, heavy grain {style}

lines.text: Now you are Agent West. The prisoner whispers, look into my eyes, and you shrug, because he is wearing bed-sheets.

scenes.label: THE TURN
scenes.image_prompt: Over-the-shoulder, blurred back of {Hero} in dark Foundation jacket, closer in darkness a tall pale melted wax figure with smooth blank face, dripping hands, lit by one red emergency light, grain {style}

lines.text: Then he laughs and says they were already here, and the whole site goes quiet.

scenes.image_prompt: Dark CCTV-like frame, tall pale yellow wax figure with smooth half-melted face looming very close, out of focus, lit only by one red light, wax dripping, crushed blacks, heavy grain, desaturated {style}

lines.text: Look into my eyes. No, behind you. I'm close enough to touch your neck. Enjoy the show. Would you have noticed the wax in time?

entity_look: Humanoid figure of pale yellow wax, glossy and slightly melted, face smooth and half-formed like a mask, stitched monster features, tall stiff posture, drips of wax running from its hands.
